# Taskbar Fighters

> Pixel-art fighters on the Windows 11 taskbar, one per AI coding program in use (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, Ollama, LM Studio, Copilot CLI and more). At most two fight at a time, driven by what those programs are really doing (working, idle, waiting, sleeping, context %). 13 armed pixel-art fighters at 128 px (HD; 64 / 96 optional), a deep move set with hand-directed cinematic set pieces, fighters that stay locked on to each other, best-of-3 matches, and an optional visual-only arena mode on a whole monitor where fighters forge weapons out of the desktop (one screen grab held in RAM only, never saved; `minis.py forge off` turns it off). Python 3.12+ and Pillow; Windows 11 (tested) and macOS 13+ (experimental, CI-tested: PyObjC, fighters on the Dock, docs/MAC-TESTING.md); no network; reads only numbers and states from local transcripts and the process list. The command-line tool is `minis.py` ("minis" is the internal short name).

Quick install: `pip install taskbar-fighters` (macOS: `pip install "taskbar-fighters[mac]"`) then `taskbar-fighters start`; or the Windows zip from the latest GitHub release (TaskbarFighters.exe, no Python). To install it from source for a user, follow AGENTS.md: preflight, `git clone https://github.com/mrktchris/taskbar-fighters`, `python -m pip install -r requirements.txt`, `python -m unittest discover -s tests`, `python minis.py start`, `python minis.py status`. On a Mac: `./scripts/setup_mac.sh` (creates .venv, installs requirements-mac.txt, runs `python minis.py doctor`). Ask the user before adding any startup entry. Never edit the user's AI tool settings or hooks.

## Docs

- [README.md](https://github.com/mrktchris/taskbar-fighters/blob/master/README.md): what it does, features, every command, right-click menu, configuration, privacy and safety, how it works, known limits
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/mrktchris/taskbar-fighters/blob/master/AGENTS.md): agent install runbook, rules, troubleshooting, how to add a program or a character
- [MOVELIST.md](https://github.com/mrktchris/taskbar-fighters/blob/master/MOVELIST.md): every move, trigger and timing (generated)
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/mrktchris/taskbar-fighters/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md): V1 to v1.1.0 (2026-11-09; v1.0.0 on 2026-10-16 was the first tagged release)
- [docs/ARENA.md](https://github.com/mrktchris/taskbar-fighters/blob/master/docs/ARENA.md): arena mode options (`--rounds`, `--intensity`, `--seconds`, `--no-intro`, `--no-outro`), effects, desktop weapons and their privacy rules, the visual-only guarantee
- [docs/MAC-TESTING.md](https://github.com/mrktchris/taskbar-fighters/blob/master/docs/MAC-TESTING.md): macOS install, the checklist to verify it on a real Mac, known risks
- [RESULT.md](https://github.com/mrktchris/taskbar-fighters/blob/master/RESULT.md): build logs with what was verified and how

## Key files

- [minis.py](https://github.com/mrktchris/taskbar-fighters/blob/master/minis.py): CLI, director loop, fighter loop
- [minis_core/sources.py](https://github.com/mrktchris/taskbar-fighters/blob/master/minis_core/sources.py): program detection table (add a program here)
- [minis_platform/__init__.py](https://github.com/mrktchris/taskbar-fighters/blob/master/minis_platform/__init__.py): picks the Windows (minis_win) or macOS (minis_mac) backend
- [minis_core/config.py](https://github.com/mrktchris/taskbar-fighters/blob/master/minis_core/config.py): every setting and its default (`minis.json` overrides)
- [minis_core/forge.py](https://github.com/mrktchris/taskbar-fighters/blob/master/minis_core/forge.py): arena desktop weapons (the RAM-only screen grab, cut, morph, crack, shatter)
- [minis_core/setpieces.py](https://github.com/mrktchris/taskbar-fighters/blob/master/minis_core/setpieces.py): hand-authored set pieces (taskbar); arena_setpieces.py for the arena
- [minis_core/paths.py](https://github.com/mrktchris/taskbar-fighters/blob/master/minis_core/paths.py): where the art and minis.json live for a checkout, PyInstaller, py2app or wheel install
- [minis_core/director.py](https://github.com/mrktchris/taskbar-fighters/blob/master/minis_core/director.py): which two programs get a fighter
- [art/roster.py](https://github.com/mrktchris/taskbar-fighters/blob/master/art/roster.py): the 13 characters (add a character here, then `python art/build_fighters.py --all --only <name>`)
